pages.title: Potion of Petrification
pages.text: $(thing)Petrified$(0): lasts 30 seconds. While active, the target cannot move, use items, or attack — frozen solid as stone.$(br)$(li)Awkward Potion + $(item)Stone$(0) → Potion of Petrification$(li)Splash/lingering versions can petrify other creatures$(br)Milk cures petrification (yes, it does).

pages.title: Potion of Reveal
pages.text: $(thing)Reveal$(0): while the effect lasts, shapeshifters take on their human form; humans instead reveal the demon within.$(br)$(li)Awkward Potion + $(item)Murmol's Soul$(0) → Potion of Reveal (1 min)$(li)
